annotation.title_clean: Outline of "AI Guidelines for Business Ver1.1"
annotation.title_en: Outline of "AI Guidelines for Business Ver1.1"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications; Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (Japan)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Slide outline of Japan's voluntary AI Guidelines for Business Ver1.1 (MIC and METI). It sets ten common guiding principles and role-specific duties for AI developers, providers and business users. It takes a risk-based, living-document approach aligned with international frameworks including the Hiroshima Process. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten common guiding principles: human-centric, safety, fairness, privacy, security, transparency, accountability, education/literacy, fair competition, innovation
Duties are split across AI developers, providers and business users
Voluntary, risk-based approach with measures proportionate to risk
Updated as a living document through multi-stakeholder review
Advanced AI systems follow additional Hiroshima Process Code of Conduct matters
